description: This file implements the StandaloneSchedulerBackend class for Spark, managing cluster scheduling, executor lifecycle, and communication with the Spark standalone cluster manager.

classes.name: StandaloneSchedulerBackend
classes.description: A SchedulerBackend implementation for Spark's standalone cluster manager, managing executor lifecycle and cluster communication.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the backend, connects to the launcher if in client mode, and starts the application client.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the backend and associated resources.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles connection establishment with the Spark cluster, setting the application ID.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Handles disconnection events from the cluster.

methods.name: dead
methods.description: Handles application termination with a reason.

methods.name: executorAdded
methods.description: Logs and manages the addition of a new executor.

methods.name: executorRemoved
methods.description: Handles removal of an executor, determining the reason based on exit status.

methods.name: workerRemoved
methods.description: Handles removal of a worker node.

methods.name: sufficientResourcesRegistered
methods.description: Checks if sufficient resources are registered.

methods.name: applicationId
methods.description: Returns the application ID, with a warning if not initialized.

methods.name: doRequestTotalExecutors
methods.description: Requests total executors from the master for each resource profile.

methods.name: doKillExecutors
methods.description: Kills specified executors via the master.

methods.name: getDriverLogUrls
methods.description: Retrieves driver log URLs from environment variables.

methods.name: notifyContext
methods.description: Releases registration barrier to signal registration completion.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the backend, executor thread, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: createDriverEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new driver endpoint for communication.
